name: Hierarchical Sampling with Occupancy Grid
definition: A two-stage volume rendering method that uses an occupancy grid to skip empty space during coarse sampling, then uses hierarchical sampling to refine sample positions based on coarse weights, combining coarse and fine samples for the final render.
summary: Hierarchical Sampling with Occupancy Grid is a two-stage volume rendering method that accelerates NeRF training by decoupling coarse occupancy-guided sampling from fine weight-guided refinement.
